source: Henan Wangpai lists GPC71 in its silicon carbide range for wide and narrow belts, with wood panels, non-ferrous metals, glass and ceramics among the listed applications.
JinKaiYan describes GXK51 as aluminium oxide on X-weight cloth, closed coated, for light-load narrow belts used on metal and hardwood.
JinKaiYan identifies XZ330 as zirconia abrasive on XA-weight polycotton, for metal grinding, deburring and finishing on stainless and alloy steels, grit range 36–400.

JinKaiYan lists KX167 as aluminium oxide on X-weight cloth, closed coating, for wood panels, furniture, rattan and ordinary steel, grit range 40–400. This is a source reference, not a MoTai stock list.

Public GXK56 references differ: Little Sun lists calcined aluminium oxide on X-weight polyester with regular grits 24–600; Golden Sun lists aluminium oxide on polycotton. Confirm the raw-material manufacturer, backing and wet/dry suitability before ordering.
